title: NASA-UAP-D008, Apollo 12 Medical Debriefing - Tape 12, 1969
what_is_it: Audio recording of a post-mission medical debriefing of the Apollo 12 crew conducted by NASA.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted text available — all facts are derived from metadata and the CSV description only, not from the audio content itself.
This is an audio recording; the full content of the debriefing may contain additional details not captured in the metadata summary.
NASA's own conclusion was that these were not UAP — the light flashes were determined to be a physiological response (likely cosmic ray phosphenes), not external phenomena.
The inclusion in the PURSUE collection does not imply NASA considered these observations to be UAP-related.
